description: The measurement of the production watch build on the physical Pebble Time 2, taken from the four RD startup lines and the RD light line of a build made with RD_BUILD_LOG=1 and installed with PEBBLE_PHONE=<ip> pnpm run device. One entry per measured mode; scripts/build-report.py copies each into public/reports/comparison.json.

fields.commit: git commit of the measured build
fields.startupWallMs: wall_ms of the RD startup line: the validated slice and gap times summed until the startup and any minute refill it still owed finished (gaps of 5 s or more are excluded and flagged as interrupted)
fields.avgDrawUs: avg_draw_us (the field rendered into the framebuffer)
fields.loopMs: loop_ms of an RD_BUILD_PROFILE=1 build, 0 otherwise
fields.note: free-text context of the entry: steps, frames, burst timings, and what changed
fields.settingsLog: RD settings lines captured during this run, when available

measurements.note: Startup 1,661 steps and 551 frames in 30.03 s. A backlight window after the startup (RD light line) ran 282 steps and 93 frames in 5.05 s: 18.4 frames per second, three steps per frame.
Settings build with default settings, RD_BUILD_LOG=1 and RD_BUILD_LOAD_LIMIT=24576, 21,688 B load. Startup 1,680 steps and 557 frames in 30.01 s.

measurements.note: Run 1 on physical Pebble Time 2 with RD_BUILD_LOG=1, 19,168 B load, using pnpm run device. Startup 1,683 steps, 565 slices, and 559 draws, with since_init_ms=30,004. RD init reported mask_ms=4. The three settings lines above were captured before startup.

Run 2 on the same physical Pebble Time 2 with the same RD_BUILD_LOG=1 PBW, 19,168 B load, using pnpm run device. Startup 1,684 steps, 565 slices, and 559 draws, with since_init_ms=30,024. The log connection missed the settings lines. No settings were changed between runs 1 and 2.
